## What's New in 1.2.0

Canceled tool calls no longer count as errors, audit records show whether a failed call reached the
event broker, and tools that need a Message VPN point the agent to `list-vpns`.

Full details are in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SolaceProducts/solace-broker-mcp/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md).

### Before You Upgrade

- Audit schema — Every audit record now reports `audit_schema_version` 1.4. Update SIEM queries
  pinned to 1.3.
- Canceled tool calls — A tool call that the client cancels now reports `outcome="cancelled"`
  instead of `outcome="error"`. Alert rules and dashboard panels that count `outcome="error"` no
  longer include canceled calls. To keep counting them, add `outcome="cancelled"` to those rules
  and panels.

### Added

- The `operation` audit record includes `request_sent` for every tool call that does not succeed.
  A value of `false` means the request never reached the event broker, so nothing changed. A value
  of `true` means the server sent the request, and the event broker might have applied it.

### Changed

- The server records a canceled tool call as `outcome="cancelled"` with no `error_type` in its
  metrics, traces, audit records, and logs (`metrics_schema` 1.12). A SEMP timeout on the server
  side still counts as an error.
- Every tool that requires `msgVpnName` names `list-vpns` in that parameter's description, so an
  agent can look up the Message VPN instead of asking the user.
- The embedded SEMPv2 OpenAPI specifications match the 10.26.10 rolling release, so tool schemas
  include current event broker attributes.
